description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeTerminationDao in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases to verify the functionality of saving and retrieving employee termination records, as well as listing termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing EmployeeTerminationDao methods, including saving and retrieving employee termination records and termination reasons.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeTerminationDao instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests the saving of an EmployeeTerminationRecord and verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests fetching an EmployeeTerminationRecord by employee ID and verifies its fields.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of termination reasons.
